envelopeConflictCheck.question: Does any rank 1 amendment file conflict with REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE.md or REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE.cells.json in a way that changes an existing expected result?
envelopeConflictCheck.method: Each of the 29 cells and the 5 additionalRequirements was checked against PROPOSED-RULES.md, OPERATION-ERRORS.json and FULL-RESULT-CASES.json. Full 21-key results were compared field by field where a structurally matching amendment case exists.
fieldEqual: ordinary-sha1, origin-sha1, linked-sha1, relative-sha1, comments, shallow-complete and hostile equal normal-exit-lingering-descendant-contained (all 21 keys).
alternates and ambient-alternates equal empty-http-alternates; attributes and linked-attributes differ from it only in code, as the error table requires.
bad-marker equals metadata-CRLF and optional-attributes-EACCES (repository-object-unavailable, NOT_CHECKED).
missing-target-blob and corrupt-target-blob equal canonical-nonzero-exit (git-diff-failed, EXACT).
ruleConsistent: Envelope ID is exactly canonical-repository-bounded/1 on all 29 cells and the cancelled-context result, never bare native (OQ-08 RETAINED).
attributes, linked-attributes, comments: PROPOSED-RULES section 1 attributes grammar.
object-link, pack-link, info-link, root-link, bad-marker, linked-wrong-backpointer: section 1 no-follow set, marker grammar and reciprocity -> repository-object-unavailable.
linked-missing-common (commondir /missing/common): absolute commondir is unsupported grammar -> repository-object-unavailable, as in amendment case absolute-commondir.
missing-target-tree -> repository-object-unavailable and missing/corrupt changed blob -> git-diff-failed: stated verbatim in section 4.
origin and hostile: inert remote/user/branch settings admissible; no helper execution (section 2).
sha256 positive cells: same shape as sha1 positives, differing only in format-specific identities.
N16 to N20: consistent with amendment cancellation, containment, limits and the Darwin-only observed tuple; they set no expected result that the amendment changes.
interpretiveNotes: missing-base, corrupt-base, shallow-missing, missing-promisor expect git-read-failed. Under OPERATION-ERRORS resolve-commit this holds when the failure is observed as launch failure or child nonzero; a complete in-band missing/wrong-kind answer would map to repository-object-unavailable. The amendment does not pin the resolve-commit observation channel, so the rank 3 cells stand and fix it for these recipes. No amendment case covers a missing base commit.

REPOSITORY-ENVELOPE.md says "thirty minutes cumulative". Rank 1 (section 3) overrides it with one outer monotonic 30-minute wall deadline plus one 10-second emergency-retirement allowance. No cell depends on it.
envelopeConflictCheck.notChecked: No cell or amendment case was executed; agreement is textual and structural only.
